{{Current events|year=2017|month=12|day=12|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Unibail-Rodamco]] agrees to purchase shopping mall owner [[Westfield Corporation]] for $15.7 billion. [http://www.businessinsider.com/westfield-sells-itself-for-157-billion-2017-12 (''Business Insider'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*An explosion and fire at the Gas Connect Austria pipeline hub in [[Baumgarten an der March]] kills one person and injures 21. Service to [[Hungary]], [[Slovenia]], [[Croatia]] and [[Italy]] is suspended. Italy declares a state of emergency. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-austria-blast/deadly-blast-at-austrian-pipeline-hub-slashes-gas-flow-to-italy-idUSKBN1E614W (Reuters)] [http://www.dw.com/en/italy-declares-state-of-emergency-following-deadly-explosion-at-austrian-pipeline/a-41752272 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Peru]]
**A 22-year-old student is found dead inside the [[National University of San Marcos]], of [[Lima]], and the most important and oldest of [[Peru]]. Everything seems to indicate that he had been killed. Authorities have identified a possible suspect, who is also a student at the university. [http://larepublica.pe/sociedad/1157268-hallan-muerto-a-estudiante-en-san-marcos (''La República'')] [http://www.atv.pe/actualidad/asesino-de-erik-arena-sierra-estaria-identificado-344211 (''ATV'')] [http://www.americatv.com.pe/noticias/actualidad/san-marcos-estudiante-hallado-muerto-pertenecia-al-tercio-superior-n302991 (''América Televisión'')]

;Health and environment
*[[Regulation of chemicals]]
**Reacting to a [[European Citizens' Initiative|petition]] from more than a million [[Citizenship of the European Union|EU citizens]], the [[European Commission]] releases a 16-page report on [[glyphosate]]. It adopts a renewal of the approval of glyphosate for a 5-year period and plans to improve the science reviewing process. [http://www.lefigaro.fr/flash-eco/2017/12/12/97002-20171212FILWWW00205-la-commission-officialise-le-renouvellement-du-glyphosate.php (''Le Figaro'' and Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Syrian opposition]] urges Russian president [[Vladimir Putin]] to put pressure on Syrian president [[Bashar al-Assad]] in order to "rescue" the [[Geneva peace talks on Syria (2017)|Geneva peace talks]] and begin face-to-face bilateral talks. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/12/syrian-opposition-urges-russia-to-rescue-un-peace-talks (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Rwanda]], [[Foreign relations of France]]
**[[Rwanda]] steps up pressure on [[France]] to admit alleged complicity in the [[Rwandan genocide|1994 genocide]] by publishing a report by [[law firm]] ''Cunningham Levy Muse''. [https://www.ft.com/content/ffcbc7ea-df59-11e7-a8a4-0a1e63a52f9c (''Financial Times'')] 

;Politics and elections
*[[Government of San Francisco]]
**[[Mayor of San Francisco]] [[Ed Lee (politician)|Ed Lee]] dies of an apparent heart attack. Supervisor [[London Breed]] becomes acting Mayor. [http://www.sfgate.com/politics/article/Supervisor-London-Breed-becomes-SF-mayor-upon-Ed-12423909.php (SFGate)]
*[[United States Senate special election in Alabama, 2017]]
**Voters in [[Alabama]] go to the polls to fill the [[United States Senate]] seat vacated by current [[United States Attorney General]] [[Jeff Sessions]]. The race is between [[Roy Moore]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]) and [[Doug Jones (politician)|Doug Jones]] ([[Democratic Party (United States)|D]]). [http://www.cnn.com/2017/12/12/politics/alabama-senate-race/index.html (CNN)]
**The [[Associated Press]] declares Doug Jones the winner. [https://www.nytimes.com/elections/results/alabama-senate-special-election-roy-moore-doug-jones (AP via New York Times)]

;Science and technology
*[[Climate change in the Arctic]]
**This year's [[Arctic Report Card]] reveals that the plunge in [[sea ice]] extent as well as the amount of [[ocean surface]] [[Global warming|warming]] is unprecedented in at least the last 1,500 years. [http://mashable.com/2017/12/12/arctic-ice-melt-warming-unprecedented-1500-years-report-card/ (''Mashable'')]

;Sports
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**[[Marshall Faulk]], [[Ike Taylor]], and [[Heath Evans]] are suspended from the [[NFL Network]] due to allegations of sexual harassment. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/early-lead/wp/2017/12/12/nfl-network-suspends-marshall-faulk-ike-taylor-heath-evans-over-sexual-harassment-claims/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[EAFF E-1 Football Championship]]
**[[South Korea]] beats [[North Korea]] 0–1 in [[Tokyo]]. The [[Japan]]ese authorities gave the North Korean players a special visa to enable their participation in the event that was formerly known as the ''East Asian Cup''. [http://sporza.be/cm/sporza/voetbal/buitenland/1.3113172 (Sporza)]
